description: This Dart source file implements an OTP validation and authentication selection screen in a Flutter app. It features social sign-in options, phone number input, a continue button with testing bypass features, and navigation logic to other app screens.

classes.name: OTPValidationScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the OTP validation and social sign-in screen with phone input, skip functionality, and navigation options.

methods.name: _buildSocialButton
methods.description: Helper method to create styled social sign-in buttons (Google, Facebook, Apple).

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on the Continue button, including triple-tap bypass detection.

methods.name: _bypassLoginForTesting
methods.description: DEBUG/TESTING method that bypasses login flow by setting preferences and navigating directly to the home screen.

methods.name: _onContinueWithPhone
methods.description: Handles navigation to OTP second screen after validating phone number input.

methods.name: _onGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Simulates Google sign-in, updates preferences, and navigates to home activity.
